title: Forged in the Dark NPC (third-party content)
description: Frontmatter contract for a droppable Forged-in-the-Dark NPC. Maps to a Sled Dog World NPC entry (name/description/notes/relations columns + a rich `details` payload). Write from the Blades in the Dark SRD vocabulary; use no Duskwall setting text, NPCs, art, or maps.

slug.description: kebab-case, no leading 'the-'. Sled Dog namespaces it (e.g. ext:<author>:<slug>).

summary.description: One-line hook shown on the crew's Manage content page.

description.description: Who They Are — look, manner, voice, the tell.

faction.description: The faction they belong to or serve, if any.

role.description: Their trade or standing (a fence, a bluecoat, a spirit warden).

background.description: One paragraph: where they came from; the wound behind the want. Keep one thing hidden.

disposition.description: How they lean toward a crew by default.

quirks.description: Distinctive habits/tells the GM can play cold.

relations.description: Bonds & Relationships — loaded prompts addressed to the crew.

hooks.description: Reasons the NPC pulls a crew into motion.

images.description: Optional images shipped to the party image gallery when this module is installed (a supporter feature). Files live beside this .md in the content repo; Sled Dog serves them from GitHub raw, pinned to the content commit.

file.description: Path to the image relative to this module folder (e.g. "art/homefront.png"). No leading slash, no "..".

caption.description: Short title shown on the gallery card.

description.description: Longer notes shown when the card is expanded.

url.description: A published Supabase public URL (paid packs). Alternative to `file`.

pack.description: For paid-pack content only: the pack slug this item belongs to.
